“I came on the same errand,” Charley Tippery announced, introductions over. “The saving of Francis, as I understand it, must consist of hard cash or of securities indisputably negotiable. I have brought with me what I have hustled all night to get, and what I am confident is not sufficient——”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u030-r0129", "tag": "p", "text": "“How much have you brought?” Henry asked bluntly.", "sha256": "cae2c3d4490ede7a5809f68dead14656aeaa46ca29da2debb3c560b1f6b68143", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2633]", "source_html": "

“How much have you brought?” Henry asked bluntly.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u030-r0130", "tag": "p", "text": "“Eighteen hundred thousand—what have you brought?”", "sha256": "88dd38a5a3441d9df4bb0d6e4866ed811b4f371c31c1c4b45a6a9206d37ac978", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2634]", "source_html": "

“Eighteen hundred thousand—what have you brought?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u030-r0131", "tag": "p", "text": "“Piffle,” said Henry, pointing to the open suit-case, unaware that he talked to a three-generations’ gem expert.", "sha256": "76141dbf0cebf48310950c2aa9d4bf82b6487c88779003c09a7e8881c64f16e5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2635]", "source_html": "

“Piffle,” said Henry, pointing to the open suit-case, unaware that he talked to a three-generations’ gem expert.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u030-r0132", "tag": "p", "text": "A quick examination of a dozen of the gems picked at random, and an even quicker eye-estimate of the quantity, put wonder and excitement into Charley Tippery’s face.", "sha256": "e1ed585bd2338911f17638dc6705b2a22e6afad21fc89190ac398adea0bd021f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2636]", "source_html": "

A quick examination of a dozen of the gems picked at random, and an even quicker eye-estimate of the quantity, put wonder and excitement into Charley Tippery’s face.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u030-r0133", "tag": "p", "text": "“They’re worth millions! millions!” he exclaimed. “What are you going to do with them?”", "sha256": "e41a7c60e7338ca8d46e4d7d60dafed23071b48e5bd5986d4686673baaf1e695", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2637]", "source_html": "

“They’re worth millions! millions!” he exclaimed. “What are you going to do with them?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u030-r0134", "tag": "p", "text": "“Negotiate them, so as to help Francis out,” Henry answered. “They’re security for any amount, aren’t they?”", "sha256": "3911eff4ddb395d6fd504ca88bb673fe8854ce0330cd012d3fda8a62ef4bdcfc", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2638]", "source_html": "

“Negotiate them, so as to help Francis out,” Henry answered. “They’re security for any amount, aren’t they?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u030-r0135", "tag": "p", "text": "“Close up the suit-case,” Charley Tippery cried, “while I telephone!—I want to catch my father before he leaves the house,” he explained over his shoulder, while waiting for his switch. “It’s only five minutes’ run from here.”", "sha256": "651fe0ce951a8747fcb490e5f0f31fc98681f82a598f8aa70f1c5054b668345c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2639]", "source_html": "

“Close up the suit-case,” Charley Tippery cried, “while I telephone!—I want to catch my father before he leaves the house,” he explained over his shoulder, while waiting for his switch. “It’s only five minutes’ run from here.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u030-r0136", "tag": "p", "text": "Just as he concluded the brief words with his father, Parker, followed by a police lieutenant and two policemen, entered.", "sha256": "103dd48914255c9f9d47b590ec94ad1760314d10a87aa914761840cc57a9f2b2", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2640]", "source_html": "

Just as he concluded the brief words with his father, Parker, followed by a police lieutenant and two policemen, entered.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u030-r0137", "tag": "p", "text": "“There’s the gang, lieutenant—arrest them,” Parker said.—“Oh, sir, I beg your pardon, Mr. Tippery. I don’t know what the charge will be—crazy, anyway, if not worse, which is more likely.”", "sha256": "20336d404c1eb7c338f8d336c7dc0e4966ce40f35214a390b41d208508b27dc8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2641]", "source_html": "

“There’s the gang, lieutenant—arrest them,” Parker said.—“Oh, sir, I beg your pardon, Mr. Tippery. Not you, of course.—Only the other two, lieutenant. I don’t know what the charge will be—crazy, anyway, if not worse, which is more likely.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u030-r0138", "tag": "p", "text": "“How do you do, Mr. Tippery,” the lieutenant greeted familiarly.", "sha256": "fd419bc6e6f4b31229b19a1aa53310ddc297823a4fb96e1a3ede738d61042d8f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2642]", "source_html": "

“How do you do, Mr. Tippery,” the lieutenant greeted familiarly.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u030-r0139", "tag": "p", "text": "“You’ll arrest nobody, Lieutenant Burns,” Charley Tippery smiled to him. “You can send the wagon back to the station. I’ll square it with the Inspector. For you’re coming along with me, and this suit-case, and these suspicious characters, to my house. You’ll have to be bodyguard—oh, not for me, but for this suit-case. There are millions in it, cold millions, hard millions, beautiful millions. When I open it before my father, you’ll see a sight given to few men in this world to see.—And now, come on everybody.
